analysis: The model still likes Houston by 5.2 net points, well beyond the markets -2.5, driven mostly by an Elo edge (1531 vs 1449). That gap now has a second, corroborating signal it lacked before: WR1 Nico Collins (hamstring) is back after missing three straight games, confirmed as a full practice participant Friday and saying himself hell play -- Houstons passing offense was running without its top target for exactly the stretch the model is drawing recent form from.

Dallas has its own recurring secondary/linebacker injury questions (Durant, Hooker, Overshown, Locke all carrying designations again), but nothing firm enough yet to price as a adjustment -- worth a tighter look if Dallas official designations harden further.
